sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your offer; we value our long-standing relationship and understand that larger price steps need committee approval. Our order volume represents our full demand for this part, and our rising forecast together with a long contract term offers planning security; could you review the base price and alloy surcharge with your pricing committee, perhaps walking us through the calculation as your owner once offered?

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We thank you for your detailed response and the proposal for a 36-month contract with 45-day payment terms, which allows us to revise our offer to €5.60 per unit.
However, we cannot agree to a fixed price over such an extended period and must include the AS-14404 index clause to account for raw material volatility.
Our colleagues will address your questions regarding the cost breakdown and price basis separately.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate your movement in the last reply and understand that raw-material volatility matters to your calculation. Our volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, with a rising forecast and a long contract term that supports your planning; our proposal moves toward you again in recognition of that. We value the relationship and would welcome the owner’s offer to walk us through the calculation as we continue the discussion.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.83 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 45 days net, 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing communication with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

You mention that your volume represents your full demand; please provide the exact volume figures so we can review this claim. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. We look forward to your decision and hope to continue serving your business.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
